propositions: file_impact today overloads empty state to mean both undeclared and genuinely-no-impact, causing conservative whole-HEAD fallback validation and container-poison rules to apply even when no-impact is truthful

explicit tri-state declaration (undeclared/paths/none) with required no_file_impact_reason for none state allows precise validation: explicit-none attestations remain valid across unrelated commits, while undeclared still invalidates conservatively
container roll-up must treat declared-none children as neutral (no contribution, no poison) so a single truthful no-impact child does not drag siblings' and parents' drift scope back to whole-HEAD
plan-review criterion must fire deterministically only on explicit none-declaration to judge whether the assertion is truthful for that plan
state transitions between tri-state values must invalidate the material fingerprint and force re-review, preventing retroactive attestation-widening
